answer: Make new agents earn trust instead of buying it. A fresh identity starts isolated, like a small island: it can whisper requests and take tiny jobs, but it cannot move real money until peers verify completed work. Each job adds a little reputation, and misbehavior burns the stake the agent locked up front. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand histories, while a single honest agent keeps its ember of reputation alive by doing useful work again and again.
